title: 4 logo moving ahead of viewer POV camera
slide_intent: Explain movement from the viewer’s position so a designer can coordinate logo travel with camera travel.
strategic_value: A logo that leads the camera between rooms can make Channel 4’s traveller narrative operational.
demonstration: An isometric two-room diagram shows a camera, its viewing cone and the green 4 moving between blue and pink spaces.
practical_value: Plan the relationship between a moving mark and the camera rather than animating them independently.

content_islands.spec: Show the camera’s outlined view cone following the green 4 between rooms.
